definitions.explanation: A warship designed to escort and protect other vessels. In modern Japanese usage, this is the official designation for Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force (JMSDF) destroyers, since the postwar constitution avoids overtly military terminology.

examples.japanese: {護衛艦|ごえいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入港|にゅうこう}→入港：14771_nyuukou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An escort ship entered the port.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新型|しんがた}→新型：19411_shingata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{護衛艦|ごえいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{就役|しゅうえき}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{海上自衛隊|かいじょうじえいたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{護衛艦|ごえいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧⟦{共同|きょうどう}→共同：02591_kyoudou⟧⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: A JMSDF escort ship participated in an international joint exercise.

notes:
{護衛艦|ごえいかん} is the official classification for Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force ({海上自衛隊|かいじょうじえいたい}) surface combatants. Literally "escort vessel."

CULTURAL NOTE:
In other navies, these ships would be classified as destroyers or frigates. Japan uses the euphemistic term {護衛艦|ごえいかん} because the postwar constitution limits military capability to self-defense, and overtly military terminology like ⟦{駆逐艦|くちくかん}→駆逐艦：23389_kuchikukan⟧ (destroyer) is avoided.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {護衛艦|ごえいかん}{隊|たい}: escort ship squadron
- {護衛艦|ごえいかん}{隊群|たいぐん}: escort flotilla
- ⟦{新型|しんがた}→新型：19411_shingata⟧{護衛艦|ごえいかん}: new-model escort ship
- {護衛艦|ごえいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{就役|しゅうえき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: an escort ship is commissioned

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{空母|くうぼ}→空母：15702_kuubo⟧: aircraft carrier
